text: This report summarizes the program items at the Community Liaison Consultation meeting held on April 20, 2021, and the comments and questions raised by community members at that meeting. Hosting the meeting were Board Members: Paula Oliveira and Peter Leon. Exhibition Place staff in attendance included Don Boyle = CEO; Laura Purdy - General Manager; Tony Porter - Director, Transportation and Security; Gilles Bouchard - Director, Event Management Services; Kelvin Seow - Director, Stakeholder Management and Strategic Planning; Debbie Sanderson- Executive Assistant to the CEO; Nigel Fernandes, IT Systems, and Catherine de Nobriga, Tenant Relations Coordinator. Representatives from Hotel X and Metrolinx also made presentations. There were 41 members of the community attending the meeting. The meeting lasted approximately two hours with active participation by the community.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (June 2, 2021) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place for information.
